cases.sentence: Господи, Бог Израиля, молю Тебя, скажи ___!
cases.explain: «Твоему слуге» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: Will the men of Keilah deliver me up into his hand? Will Saul come down, as your servant has heard? Yahweh, the God of Israel, I beg you, tell your servant.” Yahweh said, “He will come down.”

cases.sentence: Давид был в ___ в пустыне, в горах пустыни Зиф.
cases.explain: «неприступных местах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: David stayed in the wilderness in the strongholds, and remained in the hill country in the wilderness of Ziph. Saul sought him every day, but God didn’t deliver him into his hand.

cases.sentence: Разведайте все его укрытия, где он прячется, и возвращайтесь ко мне с ___.
cases.explain: «достоверными сведениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: See therefore, and take knowledge of all the lurking places where he hides himself, and come again to me with certainty, and I will go with you. It shall happen, if he is in the land, that I will search him out among all the thousands of Judah.”
